packageRules.description: Don't let Renovate bump the constraints.npm cap above. It's a workaround for npm 12's EALLOWREMOTE bug (npm/cli#9800), removed by hand (see todo/FUTURE.md in the homelab repo), not by an update PR.
Keep Node on the active LTS line (the Dockerfile and ui/.nvmrc must agree).
typescript-eslint doesn't support TypeScript 7 yet; hold the compiler below 6.1 until it does.
Keep the go directive (which CI's setup-go builds with) on the latest patch release, so govulncheck sees the fixed standard library.
